voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: For more than twenty years, the most trusted man in a small English town was its doctor.
beats.cap:
THE MOST TRUSTED
MAN IN TOWN

beats.vo: In their own front rooms, he killed at least two hundred and fifteen of his patients.
Mostly elderly women. An injection, in the afternoon. It looked like sleep.
He was never caught by the killing. He was caught by a forged will.
And someone had already seen it — another doctor — and been ignored.
The full story is on the channel.
beats.cap:
THE FULL STORY
IS ON THE CHANNEL
